page.layout: One page of text, centred; no margins, no running head, no page number. Blocks from top to bottom: the author line "AUCTORIS", the title "Creia Philosophica", the subtitle in italic, the motto "Qui unam habet omnes habet virtutes.", and the italic note of origin in three lines.

l.i: Defumpta ex ejus Collegio oratorio, & propter materiâ affinitatem Ethicâ adjunêta.

page.notes: Title page with only printed lines; the decorative marks on the scan are stains and not text. The hyphen in "ha-bet" is a printed line-end hyphen. Long s written as plain s. The italic note is set in a smaller italic type; the first letter of "super" and the ligatures in "Defumpta" are as printed.
